(2) Date-agnostic in-progress grid sweep — on every create-bound path (not approved-reuse), deletes ALL pending Terminat rows for this EID regardless of effdt. The sweep is the only mutation and is dry-run-guarded. Skipped when txnNumberPrefilled.

After step: dates reconciled → lastDayWorked = Kronos last punch (overrides Kuali); separationDate = max(LDW, sick, holiday); termEffDate = sep+1. Conditional write-backs to Kuali (live only, gated on ldwChanged / separationDateChanged).

operations.note: Keyword match on 'housing'/'dining'/'hospitality' — not a single dept-code. Only skips on POSITIVE non-HDH determination

operations.label: Verify Transaction Number Still Filled Before Save

operations.label: Click Save (navbar)
operations.note: IRREVERSIBLE WRITE. 3-deep .or() chain: action-bar → nav → generic role button. Scrolls to top first. Waits for networkidle (critical for batch mode)

notes: Step order: kuali-extraction → identity-check → transaction-check → ucpath-job-summary → kronos-search → ucpath-transaction → kuali-finalization

Dry-run boundary: after date reconciliation (end of kronos-search), before Kuali LDW/sep-date write-backs and ucpath-transaction. Both UCPath submit and Kuali save are skipped. The two benign residuals on the unsubmitted draft (timekeeper fill, similar-branch name correction) remain.

Department gate: UCPath Workforce Job Summary department (fetched inline before identity-check) gates kronos-search. Non-HDH → skip kronos-search, dates fall back to Kuali verbatim. HDH → read timecard. Fail-safe: unknown/empty dept still runs.

Date model: lastDayWorked = Kronos last physical punch ?? Kuali LDW. separationDate = (kronos ran) ? max(LDW, sickDates, holidayDates) : Kuali separationDate verbatim. termEffDate = separationDate+1. Write-backs to Kuali when changed (live only).
ctx.parallel in kronos-search: New Kronos timecard + Kuali timekeeper fill run concurrently via ctx.parallel settled semantics (non-fatal throw via logSettledRejection).
Transaction-check two concerns: (1) SS Smart HR effdt-gated approved-reuse; (2) date-agnostic in-progress grid sweep on every create-bound path.
UCPath frame: ALL PeopleSoft interactions use getContentFrame(page) → #main_target_win0 FrameLocator. PeopleSoft overlay intercepts Playwright clicks on some controls → JS-eval escape hatch.
